card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A digit (often 3, 6 or 5) or separator partway through a number of two or more digits, before the final digits come. Seen in doses, counts, years and week numbers.

modes.label: Middle digit
modes.description: The second digit of a number such as 43, 23 or 26 is read before the rest of the number.
